RAIL.stands_in_for: the logic rail at the top of the regulator's accuracy

RLEAK.stands_in_for: the controller pin's own input leakage at the datasheet maximum, as the resistance that sources it from the rail; after reset every port is a floating input, so that leakage is the only current there is

RPULLDOWN.stands_in_for: the gate's pull-down at its nominal value

RSERIES.stands_in_for: the gate's series element at its nominal value

RSTBYDOWN.stands_in_for: the mode pin's pull-down at its nominal value

RSTBYUP.stands_in_for: the transceiver's own pull-up on its mode input, as the resistance that sources its datasheet maximum low-level input current from the interface supply

description: an output gate and the transceiver's mode input in the state a controller that has not started leaves them, with each one's pull-down against the only current there is
name: gates_and_mode_pin_with_nothing_driving_them
